symptom: Users integration test timed out on the first CI run of the day with a connection timeout error
rootcause: The users integration test was pointed at the Neon cloud Postgres branch (TEST_DATABASE_URL). Neon free tier suspends the database after inactivity and takes 3-5 seconds to wake on first connection. This exceeded the test connection timeout and caused intermittent CI failures
fix: Migrated the users integration test from Neon to a local Testcontainers Postgres instance, eliminating the cold-start dependency
